description: This file contains unit tests for tenantClient utility functions such as normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant, utilizing Jest testing framework.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of tenant identifiers to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and notifies the server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the preferred active tenant in local storage, replacing legacy keys.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from local storage.
